candidates.learner_sentence: 日曜日は走りませんかった。
candidates.corrected_sentence: 日曜日は走りませんでした。
candidates.reason_en: The past of 「〜ません」 is 「〜ませんでした」. 「ませんかった」 borrows the ending an い-adjective takes.
candidates.native_check: replaced a duplicate repair (eval-008 repaired to the same sentence); negative past, a form no item used

candidates.learner_sentence: 雨が降るたら、行きません。
candidates.corrected_sentence: 雨が降ったら、行きません。
candidates.reason_en: 「〜たら」 attaches to the past form, so 「降る」 becomes 「降ったら」. 「降るたら」 is not a form the verb has.
candidates.native_check: replaced a mislabel — a phrase moved behind the main clause drops its particle; conditional, a form no item used

candidates.reason_en: For years, months and days, 「〜前」 attaches to the bare number: 「二年前」. 「二年間」 is how long something lasted, not when it happened.
candidates.native_check: replaced a repair that differed from eval-075's only by its question mark; duration vs point in time

candidates.learner_sentence: 忙しいから、運んでくれてありがとう。
candidates.corrected_sentence: 忙しいのに、運んでくれてありがとう。
candidates.reason_en: 「から」 gives a cause. Thanking someone for doing something in spite of something else takes 「のに」.
candidates.native_check: replaced a duplicate repair (eval-028 repaired to the same sentence); wrong connective joining two clauses

candidates.reason_en: Said to the colleague who is waiting for you, the plain 「行く」 is too blunt. The polite form is 「行きます」.
candidates.native_check: the old repair 「待ちます」 was eval-109's mistake, and the old sentence put the learner in the waiting role the scene gives the colleague

candidates.learner_sentence: お待たせさせてすみませんでした。
candidates.corrected_sentence: お待たせしてすみませんでした。
candidates.reason_en: 「お待たせします」 already means keeping someone waiting. Adding 「させ」 makes it causative a second time.
candidates.native_check: the old repair 「時間が要ります」 is not what is said on a call about being late, and が-omission was already eval-052 and eval-054; causative doubling instead, a form no item used

candidates.reason_en: Being called by someone takes the passive 「呼ばれました」. 「呼びました」 says you did the calling.
candidates.native_check: replaced a mislabel — 「今日」 is adverbial and needs no 「は」, as eval-107's own reason says; passive, a form no item used

candidates.learner_sentence: たくさんありがとうございます。
candidates.corrected_sentence: 本当にありがとうございます。
candidates.reason_en: 「たくさん」 counts things. How much you mean it is 「本当に」 or 「どうも」.
candidates.native_check: replaced a duplicate repair (eval-026 repaired to the same sentence, across batches)

candidates.learner_sentence: 今日はお世話しました。
candidates.corrected_sentence: 今日はお世話になりました。
candidates.reason_en: 「お世話する」 is what you do for someone else. Thanking someone who looked after you, it is 「お世話になりました」.
candidates.native_check: replaced a repair contained in eval-027's; direction of お世話する / お世話になる

candidates.learner_sentence: コーヒーを二枚ください。
candidates.corrected_sentence: コーヒーを二杯ください。
candidates.reason_en: Cupfuls are counted with 「〜杯」. 「〜枚」 counts flat things such as sheets of paper and plates.
candidates.native_check: the old repair 「水が欲しいです」 is not said to a shop assistant, and the first replacement shared its shape with eval-100 and eval-042; counter instead
